prompts.change_policy: Any text or configuration change creates a new prompt version; all phase-one arms use byte-identical text.
The edit list in prompts.py is the change history; it must remain an exact transformation of the parent.

phase_two_protocol.status: protocol only; no model-specific tuning is authorized in Experiment 5
requirements: Create a new prompt id with parent_id and target_models.
Document every text and decoding change before running it.
Keep the fixed phase-one prompt result as the untuned baseline.
Use a development slice for tuning and preserve a locked holdout for comparison.
Never compare tuned and untuned arms as though prompt identity were held constant.
